name: FA_DEPRN_OVERRIDE
description: FA_DEPRN_OVERRIDE contains depreciation information provided by users which overrides system calculated depreciation amounts.

columns.name: DEPRN_OVERRIDE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation override transaction.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique book identification name.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset number.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Asset book depreciation calendar period name.

columns.name: DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: Asset depreciation expense amount.

columns.name: BONUS_DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: Bonus depreciation expense. Amount included in DEPRN_AMOUNT.

columns.name: SUBTRACTION_FLAG
columns.description: Subtraction method indicator for depreciation override calculation.

columns.name: USED_BY
columns.description: Transaction that will use the depreciation override. Possible values are ADJUSTMENT, and DEPRECIATION.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the override depreciation.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset transaction.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: SUBTRACT_YTD_FLAG
columns.description: Subtraction method indicator for depreciation expense calculation. Possible values are Y for depreciation expense calculation using the subtraction method and N or Null for depreciation expense calculation not using the subtraction method.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments about the depreciation override entry.

columns.name: PRIOR_STATUS
columns.description: Prior status of the override depreciation.

columns.name: ERROR_MSG
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Encoded message text associated with a failure of the validation process.

columns.name: PRIOR_DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: Prior asset depreciation expense amount.

columns.name: PRIOR_BONUS_DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: Prior bonus depreciation expense amount. Amount included in PRIOR_DEPRN_AMOUNT.
